input: same frozen causal790; shared representation comparison, not independent end-to-end feature learning

data.inner_group_split: capture union shared device/session/component; SHA modulo5 validation; fail closed if either class missing
data.source_cal_role: normal only, final threshold 1% hierarchical weighted FPR; never tune/early stop
data.frontend_fit_scope_disclosure: frozen shared encoder previously learned source FIT including inner validation; not independent representation validation

normalization: Any model-specific normalizer fitted inner training only, then refitted full legal FIT after selection; normal-only methods fit normal training only; never target/CAL fitting

tuning.other_trials: 15 deterministic random configurations sampled once and SHA sealed before any validation score
tuning.selection_metric: source inner validation normalized weighted partial ROC AUC up to FPR .02
tuning.source_validation_attack_labels: available for selection equally; normal-only objectives still never train on attacks
tuning.cap_hit_rule: if validation still improving at cap or wall cap aborts, label incomplete; extend justified contract before reporting as fully trained

ModernNCA.PLR: author frozen default; n_blocks0; full backward gate required

final_training.refit: full legal source FIT; use selected epoch count from inner validation, no target early stop
final_training.checkpoints: save optimizer, RNG, sampler cursor, input SHA, config SHA; verify exact resume before long job
final_training.ensemble: arithmetic mean of same-method seed scores, separate CAL threshold; no cross-method score average

evaluation.head_table: all baseline RAW versus frozen main RAW on identical790 and same query UIDs
evaluation.system_table: main C5_3D_OLD with legal target normal reference shown separately; explicitly disclose extra reference and do not call unmatched RAW comparison equal-information end-to-end proof
evaluation.C5_on_baselines: not silently applied; needs separately sealed own source score scale and common legal reference access
evaluation.target_acceptance: FPR<.02 and TPR>=.999 are reporting targets, never tuning targets

resources.formal: per-method actual full training/validation/I/O plus 50% time headroom; memory measured plus30%; request changed allocation before formal launch if current resources insufficient

gates: whole epoch plus source validation timing before wall budget finalization
all trial configurations and seeds frozen before tuning
